name: compass
title: Compass
description: Object: Heading input and readout. A liquid-damped compass. The card swings past the mark and settles while a lit display reads the bearing. Your hand turns the knurled bezel, one click a degree.

docs:
Compass is in tactile/compass/. Open tactile/compass-example.html to see it run; compass.mjs is the class, compass.css its look.
Load both or it renders unstyled: in a bundler such as Vite, import './tactile/compass/compass.css' next to the .mjs import (or link it in plain HTML), then construct it on an element as the example does.
Docs: https://tactileui.dev/objects/compass
